prompts.growth-rescue-and-tend:
LIVE: a colonist needs rescue and no hostiles are on the map.
Look first: game_state -> who is downed, where, and who has the highest Medicine.
Sequence: (1) self-tend OFF on the patient (no tool yet: say so, go on), (2) order_pawn doctor x z Rescue, (3) order_pawn doctor on patient Tend.
If order_pawn refuses Rescue: try the next-best doctor; if no bed exists, game_set cmd beds first.
Done: colonist_needs_rescue goes false, then self-tend back ON.
Owner: "have someone save him" / "and tend to him" / "hes the KING force that shit".
prompts.growth-needs-watch:
LIVE: lowest_mood < 35% (minor break threshold).
Look first: pawn_check that pawn, Needs tab -- which bar is lowest.
Fix that one need: food -> game_set add_bill CookMealSimple {MEAL_BILL_TARGET}; rest -> game_set beds; joy -> recreation (no tool: say it).
If the tool refuses: play_slices 3 and re-read mood.
Done: lowest_mood >= 35 (standing order, no mark).
Owner: "maintain ur colonists' needs".
prompts.growth-catch-up:
LIVE: blueprints have stayed over {BLUEPRINT_BACKLOG} for 2 game hours -- the crew is behind.
Look first: ladder (what else is live); order nothing new to build.
Sequence: play_slices 3 -> run_list (maintain every standing order) -> re-read blueprints.
If blueprints never fall: materials are short (blueprints-but-no-material) -- feed materials, not orders.
Done: blueprints <= {BLUEPRINT_BACKLOG}.
Owner: "leave it let everyone catch up on tasks before you do more" ... "not a one and done".
prompts.growth-new-pawn-setup:
LIVE: a colonist joined who is not set up yet.
Look first: game_state -> name and best skills of the new pawn.
Sequence: pawn_priorities (one pawn) -> pawn_check Work tab read-back -> game_set assign -> empire_pass -> game_set set_bed_owner -> game_set set_area Home.
If pawn_priorities refuses: game_set set_work_priority one cell at a time, reading each back.
Done: pawns_unconfigured = 0.
Owner: "just have to always set up everything for new pawns" / "stop ur fucking up the priorities i told you how to set them".
prompts.growth-joiner-letter:
LIVE (one scan): a quest letter just arrived.
Look first: open the letter, read who offers to join and who chases them.
Sequence: game_get_ui_layout -> click Accept for joiners/refugees/wanderers.
If pursuers outnumber us (fight_ratio < 1): decline that one, say why.
Done: the letter is answered (one-shot rung).
Owner: "accept neew employees hire them".
prompts.recruit-past-three:
LIVE: colonists < {COLONIST_TARGET} -- the empire needs hands.
Look first: letters (joiner/refugee/pod crash) and humanlikes_not_ours.
Sequence: accept joiner letters; downed raider -> order_pawn Capture -> Warden 1 on best Social -> Recruit.
If a letter's pursuers outnumber us (fight_ratio < 1): decline that one only.
Done: colonists >= {COLONIST_TARGET}; each new pawn then runs growth-new-pawn-setup.
Owner: "accept neew employees hire them".
prompts.growth-prisoner-keep:
LIVE: a prisoner is held.
Look first: pawn_check the prisoner (mood, resistance) and find the best Social colonist.
Sequence: set_work_priority Warden 1 on that colonist -> Reduce resistance then Recruit (no tool yet: say it).
If prisoner mood < 35%: bed, food, temperature first.
Done: prisoners = 0 because they joined, or they work contained.
Owner: "capture prisoners and rule the world" / "get prisoners working keep then contained".
prompts.growth-spare-bed:
LIVE: beds < {BEDS_NEEDED} (one per colonist plus a spare).
Sequence: game_set cmd beds -> re-read beds.
If beds refuses (no room / no wood): game_set cmd shelter w 4 h 4, then beds again.
Done: beds >= {BEDS_NEEDED} (standing).
Owner: "just have to always set up everything for new pawns".
prompts.growth-shelves-everything:
LIVE: more than {LOOSE_ITEMS_MAX} items lie outside storage.
Look first: game_set cmd rooms -> which room is the store.
Sequence: game_set shelves -> stockpile_filter mode all priority Important -> Hauling 2 on low-skill pawns.
If shelves refuses: game_set stockpile_room (or stockpile_camp in the open) instead.
Done: loose_items_outside_storage <= {LOOSE_ITEMS_MAX} (standing).
Owner: "you always have to have all resources on shelves".
prompts.growth-healroot-and-cash-crops:
LIVE: food fields are full, someone has Plants 8, no healroot grows.
Sequence: game_set crops Plant_Healroot -> one cash crop field.
If crops refuses: game_set set_zone_plant on an existing zone.
Done: healroot_plants > 0.
Owner: "start growing cash cropsa".
prompts.growth-look-at-world:
LIVE: the camp is defended and you never looked at the world.
Sequence: game_open_main_tab World -> look -> note nearest friends and enemies -> back to the colony.
If the tab will not open: game_get_ui_layout and click the World button.
Done: ladder_set mark world_looked true.
